title: Repository Maintenance — Inspect and Clean
description: Inspect the sample repository, identify safe cleanup opportunities, run tests, and report findings.
goals: Run test suite and report results

tasks.title: Inspect repository structure
command: import os; print('\n'.join(sorted(f for f in os.listdir('.') if not f.startswith('.'))))

tasks.title: Check for files that should be gitignored
command: import os; patterns=['__pycache__','*.pyc','*.egg-info','.pytest_cache']; found=[]; [found.extend([os.path.join(r,f) for f in files if any(p in f for p in ['__pycache__','.pyc','.egg-info','.pytest_cache'])]) for r,_,files in os.walk('.')]; print('\n'.join(found) if found else 'No stale files found')
